clue.text: Careless agent must accept cut

indicators.note: the agent's word takes the cut inside it, as if accepting it

parts.note: a secret agent is a spy
to lop is to cut off

explanation.surface: An agent who agrees to a pay cut is being careless with their own interests.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: slapdash, slipshod work is careless work.

clue.text: Primates set up fixed charge for divorce

indicators.note: in a down clue set up means written upwards, reversed

parts.note: apes are primates
a rate is a fixed charge

explanation.surface: Monkeys arranging a flat fee for a split.
explanation.definitionFit: To divorce two things is to part or disconnect them.

clue.text: Dismissing head, secretly or in public?

indicators.note: the first letter of the word for secretly is dismissed

parts.note: covertly means secretly

explanation.surface: Getting rid of the boss: done privately or openly?
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the first letter flips the meaning to its opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: Done openly, in plain view rather than hidden.

clue.text: Parking at last no different after delivery

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

indicators.note: different means the letters of at last no are put in another order

explanation.surface: Finally finding a parking space feels no different after a delivery.
explanation.walkthrough: Delivery is childbirth, not a parcel.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the period after a birth, i.e. after a baby is delivered.

clue.text: Junior to follow one expected to lose

parts.note: a junior is under someone else in rank
to dog someone is to follow them closely

explanation.surface: A junior employee told to trail along behind the expected loser.
explanation.definitionFit: The competitor tipped to be beaten is called by this name in sport and politics.

clue.text: Financial problem of film actors' union?

parts.note: a negative is developed photographic film
Equity is the name of the British actors' trade union

explanation.surface: A money worry for the performers' trade union.
explanation.definitionFit: Owing more on a mortgage than the home is worth is a classic financial problem.

clue.text: Run over

definitions.meaning: in cricket a run not scored off the bat, such as a bye or wide

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a cricket run not credited to the batsman and also means surplus or additional.

clue.text: Understand a line should be put under it displaying numbers

indicators.note: in a down clue, the a and line go below the it

parts.note: dig is slang for understand

explanation.surface: An instruction to draw a line beneath a figure, displaying numbers.
explanation.definitionFit: A digital clock or display shows figures rather than hands.

clue.text: Upset, being drawn?

definitions.meaning: to draw a fowl or fish is to remove its innards

explanation.surface: Annoyed about ending a game level.
explanation.walkthrough: Drawn looks like a tied match or a sketch, but it is drawing as in hanged, drawn and quartered: disembowelled.
explanation.definitionFit: Means both very disappointed and, literally, having had the guts removed.

clue.text: Person whose creative interest is flagging?

definitions.text: Person whose creative interest is flagging?

parts.words: Person whose creative interest is flagging?
parts.note: flagging seems to mean waning, but here it means paving flagstones: someone who draws chalk pictures on the footway

explanation.definitionFit: A street performer drawing chalk pictures on paving stones for passers-by's coins.

clue.text: The newspapers joke about name for Shanghai

parts.note: the press means newspapers collectively

indicators.note: the joke's word goes round the abbreviation, so it is about it

parts.note: a gag is a joke

explanation.surface: Newspapers making a joke about a name connected with the Chinese city.
explanation.walkthrough: Shanghai looks like the city, but here it is the verb: to kidnap someone into serving as a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: Both verbs mean forcing someone into service, originally by kidnapping men for ships' crews.

clue.text: Penny-pinching drunk

explanation.surface: A miser who is also inebriated.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally the word means both stingy with cash and intoxicated.

clue.text: Escort always holding one back

indicators.note: back says the whole assembly is read in reverse
the word for always holds the word for one inside it

parts.note: e'er is the poetic contraction of ever, meaning always
a unit is one

explanation.surface: An escort who always keeps one person back.
explanation.walkthrough: E'er is the poetic shortening of ever; 'back' reverses everything once the one is inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An escort is a group of attendants, the entourage of an important person.

clue.text: Ceremonial drink that is a snack

parts.note: a toast is a drink raised in honour of someone
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A formal drink that doubles as a light bite.
explanation.definitionFit: A grilled sandwich, a common British light meal, is a snack.

clue.text: Stumped, after judge's secret meeting

indicators.note: the cricket abbreviation comes after the word for judge

parts.note: to try a case is to judge it
ST is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for stumped

explanation.surface: A judge, baffled, then off to a clandestine rendezvous.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a batsman can be out 'stumped', written ST on the scorecard.
explanation.definitionFit: A lovers' secret appointment is a rendezvous, a clandestine meeting.

clue.text: Men to go topless — possible, and highly desirable

indicators.note: topless means the first letter of the word men is dropped

parts.note: viable means feasible or possible

explanation.surface: Men going about bare-chested, claimed to be both feasible and attractive.
explanation.definitionFit: Something others covet is highly desirable.

clue.text: Slander when individual holds source of info

parts.note: as can mean when, as in as I left

indicators.note: the word for individual holds a letter inside it

parts.note: a person is an individual

indicators.note: the source of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Defamation occurs when someone holds the source of the information.
explanation.definitionFit: A damaging, disparaging remark about someone, a slur.

clue.text: Doomed, but isn't upset during action

indicators.note: the anagram sits inside the word for action

parts.note: a deed is an action

indicators.note: upset says the letters of isn't are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Ruined, though not distressed while acting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' looks like the surface's emotion but is the anagram signal on isn't; the apostrophe is ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: Fated: what is doomed is predetermined to happen.

clue.text: Course includes permit for game

indicators.note: the course word holds the permit word inside it

parts.note: a route is a course taken
to let is to permit

explanation.surface: A course of study that comes with a licence for gambling.
explanation.definitionFit: A casino game of chance played on a spinning wheel.

clue.text: Scrap not even soldiers will have time for?

parts.note: an odd number is not even
men are soldiers, as in officers and men

explanation.surface: Odd-numbered troops find time for a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: Scrap looks like a fight but means a leftover piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A leftover piece or remnant, such as a remaining bit of fabric.

clue.text: Period couch not right

indicators.note: not right means the letter for right is taken away

parts.note: to couch something is to phrase it

explanation.surface: A spell when the sofa seems wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: Couch is the verb meaning to express in words.
explanation.definitionFit: A stage or period in a process of development.

clue.text: Distress pine with no veneer

indicators.note: the veneer is the outer surface, so the first letter is stripped off

parts.note: to languish is to pine or waste away

explanation.surface: Despair at furniture made of pine lacking a decorative surface.
explanation.walkthrough: Pine pretends to be timber, fitting veneer, but it is the verb meaning to yearn.
explanation.definitionFit: Severe mental or physical suffering, agony.

clue.text: Inactivity of street without changes

parts.note: as is means in its present state, unchanged

explanation.surface: A quiet street where nothing ever changes.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of stagnation or equilibrium where nothing moves.

clue.text: Craftsman frames 'Two Pennies for Fish'

indicators.note: the craftsman's word surrounds the pennies, like a frame

parts.note: a tiler is a craftsman who lays tiles
d is the old abbreviation for a penny, so two of them are DD

explanation.surface: An artisan framing a picture with a quaint fishy title.
explanation.walkthrough: d stood for penny in Britain's pre-decimal money, from the Latin denarius.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny fish such as a minnow, or any small specimen, is so called.

clue.text: Look around a ship for rope

indicators.note: the word for look goes round the other pieces

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look
SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: Search a vessel for a rope.
explanation.definitionFit: To catch an animal with a noosed rope, as a cowboy does.

clue.text: Leading Conservative delivers post

parts.note: a side that is up is ahead or leading
the political right is conservative

explanation.surface: A senior Tory brings in the mail.
explanation.walkthrough: Post is not the mail but an upright pole.
explanation.definitionFit: A vertical post or pole in a structure is called by this name.

clue.text: Design criteria for viewing aids

definitions.meaning: short for specifications, the requirements of a design

explanation.surface: A designer's brief laid out for optical equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: One clipped word serves as shorthand both for specifications and for spectacles.

clue.text: A feeling at home schooling?

parts.note: in means at home
tuition is teaching or schooling

explanation.surface: Homeschooling gives you a certain sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A hunch or instinctive feeling about something, known without reasoning.

clue.text: Explain and begin a journey

definitions.meaning: to state or lay out an argument

explanation.surface: Describe your plans and then depart.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to lay out an argument and to set off on travels.

clue.text: Hounds agitated, as horses may be

indicators.note: agitated letters are stirred up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Restless dogs at a hunt, alongside the horses.
explanation.definitionFit: Horses without horseshoes are described as barefoot, lacking shoes.
